drawer.$description: Drawer: a panel that slides in from an edge, over the content or pushing it aside.

inset.$description: Room between the panel and the room's edges (0: on its edge, from end to end).

max-size.$description: The most of the room the panel takes.

close-button.$description: The close button in the header.

list-box.$description: A list box inside a drawer: the surface is its frame, so by default the list draws none of its own (no frame, fill or shadow); its width there (100% to fill the drawer).

scrim.$description: The scrim behind the panel (a modal drawer).

panel.$description: The panel, at an edge of the room (`start`, `end`, `top`, `bottom`: its sides towards the content and the room's edge differ); `push`: it pushes the content aside instead of lying over it.

header.$description: The header: the title and the buttons.

tools.$description: The header's buttons (the close button's look is its place's).

body.$description: The content (`focus`: it has the keys and scrolls by them, a ring inside it).

footer.$description: The footer: its buttons in a row.
